verdict.rationale: Radar rules (e.g., auto-request 3DS, auto-pause payouts on high dispute rate, auto-block by country) run autonomously in the background once configured, and risk settings can auto-adjust thresholds, satisfying the 'runs autonomously' portion of the story. However, this is rule-based configuration via dashboard/API rather than agent-driven or AI-native automation setup, and community evidence notes limited programmatic control and manual support intervention needed for overrides (stripe-radar-comm-2, stripe-radar-comm-7). Missing for 10: evidence of AI/agent-configurable automation workflows, and independent corroboration that rules run reliably without manual oversight at scale.
